    <item>
  <title>Gov. Kemp: Audi AG Selects Georgia to Invest $4 Billion in First US Manufacturing Facility</title>
  <link>https://gov.georgia.gov/press-releases/2026-10-24/gov-kemp-audi-ag-selects-georgia-invest-4-billion-first-us-manufacturing</link>
  <description>ATLANTA&nbsp;– Governor Brian P. Kemp and Gernot Döllner, CEO and Chairman of the Board of Management of AUDI AG, announced that Audi will open its first U.S. manufacturing facility in the State of Georgia. Headquartered in Ingolstadt, Germany, Audi plans to invest approximately $4 billion in a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility at the Middle Georgia Megasite, delivering approximately 4,500 new jobs to middle Georgia.</description>
  <pubDate>Sat, 24 Oct 2026 12:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>Staff</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="false">23656 at https://gov.georgia.gov/</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>Gov. Kemp Extends Suspension of State Gas Tax</title>
  <link>https://gov.georgia.gov/press-releases/2026-10-24/gov-kemp-extends-suspension-state-gas-tax</link>
  <description>ATLANTA&nbsp;– Governor Brian P. Kemp, in consultation with Lieutenant Governor Burt Jones and Speaker of the House Jon Burns, today announced he is extending a state of emergency due to global market volatility and the corresponding suspension of the state's motor fuel excise tax through November 30. With gas and diesel prices remaining high, this action will provide needed relief for Georgians through the Thanksgiving holiday travel period.</description>
  <pubDate>Sat, 24 Oct 2026 12:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>Staff</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="false">23651 at https://gov.georgia.gov/</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>ICYMI: Transformational Jobs, Investment Continue Across Georgia</title>
  <link>https://gov.georgia.gov/press-releases/2026-10-23/icymi-transformational-jobs-investment-continue-across-georgia</link>
  <description>ATLANTA -&nbsp;In case you missed it,&nbsp;Governor Brian Kemp and the Georgia Department of Economic Development under the leadership of Commissioner Pat Wilson have announced transformational job and economic growth across all four corners of Georgia throughout the late summer and early fall. Building on another record-breaking year for investments from state-worked economic development projects in FY2026, announcements have continued to be made that companies are choosing Georgia for expansions and new locations that will offer opportunities for meaningful careers for hardworking Georgians.</description>
  <pubDate>Fri, 23 Oct 2026 12:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>Staff</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="false">23646 at https://gov.georgia.gov/</guid>
    </item>
<item>
  <title>Gov. Kemp: Mitsubishi Power Doubles Footprint in Chatham County</title>
  <link>https://gov.georgia.gov/press-releases/2026-10-23/gov-kemp-mitsubishi-power-doubles-footprint-chatham-county</link>
  <description>ATLANTA&nbsp;– Governor Brian P. Kemp today announced that Mitsubishi Power Americas, Inc. (Mitsubishi Power) is investing $490 million in expanding its existing footprint in Georgia. The company plans to create more than 220 new jobs in Chatham County.</description>
  <pubDate>Fri, 23 Oct 2026 12:00:00 +0000</pubDate>

<item>
  <title>Gov. Kemp Announces Appointment to State Court of Forsyth County</title>
  <link>https://gov.georgia.gov/press-releases/2026-10-22/gov-kemp-announces-appointment-state-court-forsyth-county</link>
  <description>ATLANTA&nbsp;– Governor Brian P. Kemp today announced the appointment of&nbsp;Erin H. Fowler to the State Court of Forsyth County, filling the vacancy created by the passage of HB 750 (Act 520) during the 2026 session of the Georgia General Assembly.</description>

<item>
  <title>Gov. Kemp: Blue Bird Invests $300 Million in Peach County</title>
  <link>https://gov.georgia.gov/press-releases/2026-10-21/gov-kemp-blue-bird-invests-300-million-peach-county</link>
  <description>ATLANTA&nbsp;– Governor Brian P. Kemp today announced that Blue Bird Corporation (Blue Bird), a technology leader and innovator of school buses, is expanding its existing footprint in Peach County. The company plans to invest an estimated $300 million in a new manufacturing facility in Fort Valley, creating 375 new jobs over the next three years.</description>
  <pubDate>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 12:00:00 +0000</pubDate>

<item>
  <title>Gov. Kemp: September Net Tax Revenues Up 2.3%</title>
  <link>https://gov.georgia.gov/press-releases/2026-10-14/gov-kemp-september-net-tax-revenues-23</link>
  <description>ATLANTA&nbsp;–&nbsp;The State of Georgia’s net tax collections during the month of September totaled $3.34 billion for an increase of roughly $76.7 million, or 2.3 percent, compared to FY 2026 when net tax collections approached $3.27 billion for the month.&nbsp;Year to date, net tax revenue collections totaled $8.41 billion for an increase of $240.2 million, or 2.9 percent, compared to September 2025, when net tax collections totaled $8.17 billion through three months.</description>
  <pubDate>Wed, 14 Oct 2026 12:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
    <dc:creator>Staff</dc:creator>
    <guid isPermaLink="false">23626 at https://gov.georgia.gov/</guid>
    </item>

  <title>Gov. Kemp: VDL Groep Adds 120 New Jobs in Hall County</title>
  <link>https://gov.georgia.gov/press-releases/2026-10-13/gov-kemp-vdl-groep-adds-120-new-jobs-hall-county</link>
  <description>ATLANTA&nbsp;– Governor Brian P. Kemp today announced that VDL Groep (VDL), a global Dutch mechanical engineering and equipment manufacturer, will invest an estimated $77 million over the next several years to expand its footprint in Hall County, creating approximately 120 new jobs.</description>

<item>
  <title>Gov. Kemp Declares State of Emergency Ahead of Hurricane Isaias</title>
  <link>https://gov.georgia.gov/press-releases/2026-10-08/gov-kemp-declares-state-emergency-ahead-hurricane-isaias</link>
  <description>Atlanta, GA&nbsp;–&nbsp;Governor Brian P. Kemp today issued an updated&nbsp;State of Emergency&nbsp;for all 159 counties in preparation for Hurricane Isaias.&nbsp;The new Executive Order enables emergency management teams to make necessary arrangements and position needed resources ahead of the storm's impact. He has also directed the Georgia Emergency Management and Homeland Security Agency (GEMA/HS) to activate the State Operations Center (SOC) beginning early Friday afternoon.</description>
  <pubDate>Thu, 08 Oct 2026 12:00:00 +0000</pubDate>
